info.title: MyWaifuList API
info.description:
The MyWaifuList public API. Authenticate every request with your API key in the `apikey` header (or as an `Authorization: Bearer` token), plus the `uwu: owo` header — Cloudflare rejects anything without it before it ever reaches us. Requests are rate limited to 60 per minute.

Keys are available to Patreon supporters at the developer tier. Servers aren't free and we're broke bitches, so if you want in: [support us on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/mywaifulist).
